title: Owner Governance Evidence Gate - RRP-8.7
release_evidence_blocker: E-17 evidence must pass before Release evidence is executable
completion_condition: Owner review mechanically closed; E-17 evidence passes before Release evidence executable; Product Ready not reached until all evidence blockers close.
concrete_capability_transition: Brownie release engineering now collects and guards owner-governance evidence plus local VM/SSH release artifact bundles for branch protection, required status checks, protected tags, remote CI provenance, signing or integrity authority, independent reviews, OSS license/publish posture, and cross-platform artifact readiness while keeping incomplete targets fail-closed.

strategic_capability_mapping.transition: The release gate now includes owner-governance evidence generation and guard checks, and the existing CI-invoked VSIX check path requires the owner-governance guard.
strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: This advances runtime-release-guard-ci by turning previously prose-only owner-controlled residuals into bounded, machine-checked evidence slots without claiming the owner decisions are complete.

answers.strategic_capabilities: The phase advances headless_autonomous_development by making owner-controlled release governance residuals externally inspectable, bounded, and fail-closed in the local release gate.
answers.new_capability: A contributor can run release:owner-governance-evidence to collect GitHub protection signals, CI provenance availability, integrity decision state, independent-review state, and OSS license/publish decision state, then run guard:owner-governance-evidence to reject malformed or falsely satisfied evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Before this phase, branch protection, tag protection, independent reviews, signing/integrity authority, CI provenance, and OSS posture were documented residuals but not machine-checked evidence slots, so automation could not distinguish unavailable owner authority from completed governance.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie would continue to report owner-controlled release blockers only as prose, making autonomous release closure prone to either spinning or incorrectly declaring Product Ready.
answers.non_duplicative: This phase does not configure GitHub settings, create release tags, choose a license, sign artifacts, or approve reviews; it adds the missing evidence and guard layer around those existing owner-controlled residuals.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. No JSON-RPC method or Runtime protocol surface is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The dry-run output is existing release-gate evidence, not a new user-facing summary or Runtime diagnostic endpoint.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Build/release behavior changes: release:gate now includes local integrity verification, owner-governance evidence/guard commands, local release target validation, and local/SSH artifact bundle orchestration; readiness guards require owner-governance and local release target guard coverage in the VSIX check path.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: The autonomous release loop can now stop on precise owner-controlled evidence gaps instead of rereading overview documents or treating governance work as ambiguous implementation debt.
answers.milestone_progress: RRP-8.7 narrows runtime-release-guard-ci by closing the machine-checkable owner-governance evidence slice while preserving release-blocking owner decisions and external settings.

accepted_capability: Owner-governance and release-evidence blockers are represented as bounded, machine-checkable evidence contracts instead of prose-only residuals.
The Brownie loop can reject malformed TODO work items, repetitive workspace.write collapse, stale patch hunks, and incomplete release evidence before claiming progress.
behavior_evidence: guard:todo-contract and guard:todo-decomposition tests validate bounded TODO inputs and decomposition behavior.
guard:tool-intent-contract tests validate tool-intent schema behavior for external harness alignment.
guard:runtime-operational-evidence and guard:supply-chain-artifact-evidence tests validate fail-closed release evidence behavior.
brownie-runtime tests validate protected-read recovery and concrete TODO decomposition behavior.
safety_boundary: This phase does not declare Runtime Product Ready or Runtime Release Ready.
Incomplete artifact lifecycle, stateful soak, semantic consistency, and final release-document synchronization remain fail-closed.
External owner decisions and public-release approvals remain outside Runtime automation authority.
non_goals: Creating release tags or publishing release assets.
Replacing owner-controlled GitHub settings or independent review with automation.
Claiming that E-16 release evidence is complete.
rejected_alternatives: Treating PR or CI success alone as product-completion evidence.
Accepting broad parent TODOs without leaf-level execution contracts.
Recording raw local execution output as public release evidence.
technical_debt: phase-loop.sh remains a large shell supervisor and should later be decomposed into queue, claim, lifecycle, evidence, PR, retry, and state modules.
E-16 release evidence still requires executable artifact lifecycle, stateful soak, semantic consistency, and document synchronization work.
next_capability_rationale: The next capability is executable release-evidence closure: binding clean source identity to artifacts, running E2E artifact smoke, exercising lifecycle rollback, and replacing version-only soak with stateful soak.
Completing that evidence is required before Product Ready can be honestly claimed.

runtime_release_dod: Clean source identity is bound to generated artifacts.
Cross-platform artifact E2E smoke validates Mode Pack load, minimal task execution, ledger generation, resume, and replay rejection.
Stateful soak exercises task transitions and ledger/workspace consistency.
runtime_boundary_contracts: Runtime permissions remain authoritative over LLM instructions.
Mode Pack inputs remain external policy material compiled into runtime-enforced constraints.
Release evidence must be sanitized before it is stored in tracked files.
external_control_plane_responsibilities: GitHub branch protection, required status checks, protected tags, and workflow permissions remain owner-controlled settings.
Independent release review remains an owner-governed process.
external_adapter_responsibilities: Local VM and SSH release targets provide execution environments but are not themselves stored in the repository.
MCP account credentials and private GitHub CLI state remain under .brownie/private.
commercial_solution_readiness: Hosted scheduling, billing, RBAC, Vault, and enterprise administration remain post-v0 responsibilities.
Public release posture remains blocked until executable release evidence and owner approval are complete.

behavior_evidence: cargo test -p brownie-runtime --all-features validates Runtime behavior affected by loop recovery and TODO decomposition changes.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings validates Rust implementation quality.
pnpm --workspace-root guard:todo-contract:test validates TODO contract fixtures.
pnpm --workspace-root guard:tool-intent-contract:test validates tool-intent contract fixtures.
pnpm --workspace-root release:gate -- --dry-run validates the release gate remains fail-closed.

closed_debt: runtime-release-guard-ci existing-CI release gate dry-run binding
runtime-release-guard-ci owner-governance evidence and guard layer
non_goals: hosted services, scheduler, durable queue, supervisor, SaaS, RBAC, Vault, BDK, or Enterprise admin

reject_when: phase claims Runtime Release Ready or removes release-blocking artifact, audit, governance, workflow, review, or owner-setting evidence
pnpm --filter brownie-vsix check does not invoke pnpm --workspace-root release:gate -- --dry-run
guard:release-contract or guard:runtime-release-readiness does not fail closed when the VSIX check path omits the release gate dry-run
workflow files are modified without workflow-scope credentials or owner-approved equivalent path
license, publish settings, tags, release assets, or signing infrastructure are changed by Runtime automation

exit_criteria: pnpm --workspace-root check passes with product-completion, release-readiness, release-contract, TODO decomposition, runtime module decomposition, and phase-value guards enabled.
Release evidence remains fail-closed where executable artifact lifecycle, stateful soak, semantic consistency, or final release-document synchronization are incomplete.
Runtime Release Ready and Runtime Product Ready remain false.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: RRP-8.7 changes release/readiness guard engines and package scripts. Review must confirm owner-governance evidence remains bounded, owner-controlled settings are not self-approved, fail-closed statuses remain release-blocking, and runtime_release_ready remains false.
